services.name: SerpApi
services.what_for: Google Maps places, ratings and opening hours; Google Events and Flights
services.free_tier: 250 searches per month, 50 per hour (Free plan)
steps: Create a free account at https://serpapi.com/
Open https://serpapi.com/manage-api-key and copy your API key
Paste it when asked; it is never shown or stored in the repository

services.name: Apify
services.what_for: Scraping sites with no other source (Agoda, Klook, Google reviews at scale)
services.free_tier: USD 5 of platform usage per month, no credit card (Free plan)
steps: Create a free account at https://apify.com/
Open https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations and copy your API token
Paste it when asked. Runs spend your USD 5 monthly credit; Claude asks before each run

services.name: Google Maps Grounding Lite
services.what_for: Places, distances and driving or walking routes
services.free_tier: 10,000 free requests per month (Essentials), then USD 7 per 1,000; billing must be enabled on the Google Cloud project
steps: Create or pick a Google Cloud project and enable billing for it (https://console.cloud.google.com/)
Enable the Maps Experience agent tools API in the API Library
Create an API key, enable that API on the key and restrict the key to it
Set a daily quota on the key so you cannot be billed by surprise, then paste the key

services.name: Brave Search
services.what_for: Independent web search
services.free_tier: USD 5 of free credits per month on the Search plan (the page also advertises up to USD 20); a card is requested to prevent abuse
steps: Create an account at https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/
Subscribe to the Search plan (free credits apply; a card is requested)
Copy your API key and paste it when asked

services.name: Exa (with key)
services.what_for: Web search with higher limits than the keyless server
services.free_tier: USD 10 of free credits per month (about 2,500 Lite searches), no card; resets on the 1st
steps: Create an account at https://dashboard.exa.ai/
Open https://dashboard.exa.ai/api-keys and copy a key
Paste it when asked; it replaces the keyless Exa server for this project

services.name: Firecrawl (with key)
services.what_for: Scraping and search with higher limits than the keyless server
services.free_tier: 1,000 credits per month on the Free plan, no card
steps: Create an account at https://www.firecrawl.dev/
Copy your API key from the dashboard
Paste it when asked; it replaces the keyless Firecrawl server for this project

services.name: Claude in Chrome
services.what_for: Read sites that have no tool (Trip.com, Agoda, airline sites) in your own Chrome, with your own sign-ins
services.free_tier: Free browser extension; needs a paid Claude plan (Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise). Chrome on Mac, Windows or Linux (not WSL)
steps: Install Google Chrome if you do not have it: https://www.google.com/chrome/
Open https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/claude/fcoeoabgfenejglbffodgkkbkcdhcgfn , click Add to Chrome, then sign in to the extension with the same Claude account as Claude Code
Quit Chrome completely and open it again (it picks up the link to Claude Code only when it starts)

In the terminal: type /chrome in Claude Code and turn on 'Enabled by default' (or quit and start again with: claude --chrome). The panel must say 'Status: Enabled'; if it says 'Not connected', choose 'Reconnect extension'

In the Claude desktop app instead: Settings > Connectors > Claude in Chrome, turn it on; then in Settings set 'Preferred browser' to Claude in Chrome (type 'browser' in the settings search to find it), and start a new session
Keep Chrome open while Claude browses. Claude asks before anything that costs money or sends a message
